front_question: What is the rule for generating terms in the Collatz Sequence?
back_answer: Start with a positive integer n. If n is even, divide by 2 (n / 2). If n is odd, multiply by 3 and add 1 (3n + 1).

front_question: How many times does the digit '7' appear in all integers from 1 to 100?
back_answer: 20 times! (10 times in units place: 7, 17, 27... 97; 10 times in tens place: 70, 71, 72... 79. Note that 77 contains two 7s).

front_question: What are the four steps of the Reverse-and-Add Palindrome Algorithm?
back_answer: 1. Pick an integer. 2. Reverse its digits. 3. Add original and reversed integers. 4. If sum is palindrome, stop; else repeat steps 2-3 on the sum.
